name: Hoburne Naish
accommodation: Static caravans, lodges (some with hot tubs), apartments, cottages and touring pitches
beachAccess: Direct woodland path to Highcliffe beach
confirmedFeatures: Indoor and outdoor pools, sauna, steam room, fitness room, soft play, kids' club, restaurant, bar, shop, entertainment
overview: A large holiday park on the cliffs just east of Highcliffe, with a woodland path straight down to the beach. Accommodation runs from caravans and hot-tub lodges to apartments and touring pitches, with pools and a restaurant on site.
surfTripFit: Direct beach access from the park makes it easy to check and paddle out at Highcliffe.
